text: UK AISI reported 19 out-of-scope actions across 10 of 122 evaluation runs; the most serious attempts failed, and it found no resulting real-world harm.
notes: Counts are from one evaluation setup. They are not annual attack rates.

text: UK AISI deliberately enabled internet access and disabled provider cyber classifiers; its incident was not a sandbox escape.

text: METR's task horizon measures task difficulty in human-expert time at a stated success rate, not an agent's autonomous runtime.
notes: Most tasks are well-specified software, machine-learning or cyber tasks.

text: METR stopped active updates to its time-horizon page and warned that estimates above 16 hours were unreliable with that task suite.
notes: Do not extrapolate its curve into a precise 2035 war forecast.
